name: Carola Roth
source: Precinct Inspector Carola fled from the nation of Staven after a stint in State Security. A closeted lesbian, she lived a thoroughly repressed life before fleeing to the capitalist Five Republics. Obsessed with second-guessing other people, and imprisoned by the expectations of an oppressive society, she struggles to connect to others.
